text: In Glasgow a naked woman puts on the clothes of an inert young woman taken from the roadside and drives a van from town to town, [picking up single men with few friends|rules|how it hunts]. She leads them into a dilapidated house where they follow her into a void and sink into a liquid abyss until [only their empty skins remain|images|corpses and body parts]. After she lets a lonely man with facial tumours go, she abandons the van in the Highland fog and [tries to live among people|wants|to become something else], [studying her body in the mirror|images|mirrors and glass].
